title: Ely Outfitting Company

services.name: Canoe Rentals
services.desc: Scenic Boundary Waters canoeing day trips on lakes and rivers near Ely, Minnesota, take you to historic Native American pictographs, picturesque views, and fishing hot spots. This is a great way to get a sense of what the Boundary Waters is all about! No experience necessary. A knowledgeable and friendly guide, canoes, paddles, and life vests are included. You’ll learn some basic paddling and wilderness traveling skills, and your guide is happy to answer all your questions. The itinerary is customized to your preferences, including the time you’d like to meet for the trip and how long you’d like to be on the water.
